scripts.dev: npm run build -w @g/com && concurrently --kill-others -n COM,NXT,MCC "npm run watch -w @g/com" "npm run dev -w @g/nxt" "npm run dev -w @g/mcc"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @g/com && tsc -p com/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p nxt/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p mcc/tsconfig.json --noEmit
